mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, word_id, status, ease_factor, interval_days, repetitions, next_review_at, last_reviewed_at, correct_count, wrong_count, version FROM user_word_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND word_id = #{wordId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_word_progress ( user_id, word_id, status, ease_factor, interval_days, repetitions, next_review_at, last_reviewed_at, correct_count, wrong_count, version ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{wordId}, #{status}, #{easeFactor}, #{intervalDays}, #{repetitions}, #{nextReviewAt}, #{lastReviewedAt}, #{correctCount}, #{wrongCount}, #{version} )
mapper.update: UPDATE user_word_progress SET status = #{status}, ease_factor = #{easeFactor}, interval_days = #{intervalDays}, repetitions = #{repetitions}, next_review_at = #{nextReviewAt}, last_reviewed_at = #{lastReviewedAt}, correct_count = #{correctCount}, wrong_count = #{wrongCount}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review_logs ( client_review_id, user_id, word_id, session_id, rating, response_ms, reviewed_at ) VALUES ( #{clientReviewId}, #{userId}, #{wordId}, #{sessionId}, #{rating}, #{responseMs}, #{reviewedAt} )
